# `csharp_wrap_before_arrow_with_expressions`

When an expression body wraps, put => at the start of the new line.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `csharp_wrap_before_arrow_with_expressions = true`

```ini
max_line_length = 80
csharp_wrap_before_arrow_with_expressions = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public string Describe() =>
        $"Widget {Value} of {Value * 2}, built by the widget factory";
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public string Describe()
        => $"Widget {Value} of {Value * 2}, built by the widget factory";
}
```
:::

::::
